author: _CubeRoot
body:
Hi. If you don't know me, I'm just a regular player on the Avicus network. However, I do have a good knowledge of maps and their potential to play well (if I do say so myself). Some of the maps on Avicus have a great amount of potential and play alright, however there are a few things that should change.

Firstly, elevation. For people with lower end computers there's a few things that can cause major amounts of lag. Things like fences, large amounts of particles and such will cause lag. One of these things is elevation of maps. With so much area underneath the majority of Avicus' maps in the rotation there's a large amount of area before the void layer. I'm not sure if you've noticed, but sometimes when you place or break blocks with nothing under them other than void (really noticable when building on servers for me) you may lag spike for a second or two. By bringing the maps down a few hundred blocks to 0-20 blocks above the void layer lag caused by the void would significantly decrease.

Another issue is defending. The majority of maps on Avicus aren't made with defending in mind. This is especially evident on CTW maps. A lot of the maps on CTW are just translations (if you will) of DTMs, and that isn't a good thing. DTMs on Avicus are made with large void gaps around the monument, and that's a pretty decent pre-made defence, even though it doesn't really encourage teamwork (which is what defending is about). CTW have no void gap (from what I've seen) and a straight walk into the room, only obstructed by cobwebs. I have two major issues with this. Firstly, there's a terrible pattern of bedrock around some woolrooms (I'll get a picture from one of the maps I'm referring to shortly (probably)). It's impossible to defend if the main paths to the woolrooms have bedrock two blocks under the surface. All you can do is shave the edges off the lanes, which is completely useless. The regions around rooms on some maps are also kinda messed up (due to them just being ports of other maps). This makes maps so easy to rush, and ultimately last less than 3 minutes.
There's also no defender chests available on most maps (if not, all. I haven't seen a single defender chest and no one's answered me when I've asked about them on various maps). This means you've gotta repeatedly die to get more supplies to defend with. Two or three stacks of wood doesn't go that far while defending with items like crafting benches and pressure plates. Faster tools and such would be great for CTWs as well.

This transitions well into my final suggestion; updating the rotations. There's a lot old maps that are in the Avicus rotation that play alright, but they don't live up to the standards of the changing Avicus meta. I suggest an update in the rotations and existing maps to complement my suggestions. The rotations need maps that are defendable, lower on the y-axis and that are still fun to play.

If this is my two-cents, then I've got two bucks in my pocket that I might suggest on this thread later. For now, please consider these. Thanks.

title: [SUG] Fixing maps and updating rotations.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
You raise a lot of good points especially with the lag part. However, some maps were made with the option of "Underbridging" which is pretty self-explanatory.

Another thing is that the void gap thingy is just part of Avicus. A lot of people seem to like it including me. Especially when a sky bridge can counter this.

But you raised very sound points.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
We discussed together about defense issues and we're currently doing an (underground) map reassessment, and hopefully a meeting. All of these will be taken into account and addressed.

Thanks for the post, this is what we like
